Summary: Forgot password link is visible on sign-in page
Description: Verify the password reset entry point is available to signed-out users.
Expected Result: The "Forgot password?" link is displayed below the password field.

Summary: Registered email receives a reset link valid for 30 minutes
Description: Verify a registered customer receives a working, time-limited reset link.
Preconditions:
Customer account exists for qa.user@example.com.
Mail catcher is reachable.
Expected Result: The reset request form is displayed.
A confirmation message is shown and one reset email is delivered.

Action: Open the reset link from the email within 30 minutes.

Summary: Reset link is rejected after 30 minutes
Preconditions: A reset link was requested 31 minutes ago.
Expected Result: An "expired link" message is shown and no password form is displayed.

Summary: Unregistered email shows the same confirmation message
Description: Verify the response does not reveal whether an account exists.
Action: Submit an unregistered email on the reset form.
Expected Result: The confirmation text is identical to the registered-email case and no email is sent.

Description: Verify the 12-64 character password policy at its boundaries.
Preconditions: A valid reset link is open.
Expected Result: Validation error: password must be 12-64 characters.
Password is accepted and the success page is shown.

Action: Request a new link, enter a 65-character password and submit.
Data: '=SUM(A1) followed by 57 more characters to reach 65 total length
Expected Result: Validation error: password must be 12-64 characters.
